title: Fix Kit App Details Panel Hover Flicker
description: In the sketchpad Kit app, hovering the mouse on the details panel causes the panel to flicker and throws "Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Reflect.get called on non-object" in the browser console. The bug triggers at http://127.0.0.1:5173/kits/019db9d4-...-ac1e17f10caf. Root-cause and fix the rendering error without removing functionality.
summary: Layer parity (JS/React): selective KitEvent invalidation for SemioKitViewStore; SemioKitDesignReadStore for per-design getPieces/getConnections/getPiecesMetadata with kitEventAffectsDesignRead; SemioKitShallowListReadStore for getDesigns/getTypes/getAuthors with kitEventAffectsShallowList; React hooks use useSyncExternalStore via useSemioReadSnap instead of useEffect+broad client.subscribe. Exported KitStoreReadSnap and store getters. Extended embedded JS tests. Rust unchanged; cargo test --lib already green.
